anti_patterns: Do not use the seal as Ateles's logo, hero object, or primary metaphor. It is only a secondary state marker for a concrete authorization, commitment, approval, or completed checkpoint.
Do not literalize “swarm” with monkeys, spiders, insects, hives, honeycombs, or mascot clusters. Show a living collective through abstract named roles and relationships.
Do not render an anonymous neural-network mesh. Every visible node or path must communicate an organizational role, relationship, handoff, priority, or intervention state.

Never expose internal record IDs, entity types, field or decision keys, code-call names, repository filenames, phase bookkeeping, agent instructions, or bracketed internal scope notation on a public page.
Do not paste research analysis, source citations, or implementation-review notes into public prose. Preserve evidence in linked source artifacts and translate it into concise reader-facing claims.
Do not let motion carry organizational meaning that disappears under reduced-motion preferences; the static graph must remain legible and complete.
Do not spread authorization or withdrawal colors as general accents; reserve them for active versus withdrawn, expired, or paused authority.
Do not diverge shared structural tokens from Neotoma without a product reason; the products remain siblings through spacing, restraint, and hierarchy.
Do not reuse the Neotoma app or Inspector palette. Ateles keeps its warm paper and ink system with a rust coordination accent.
visual_styles.camera: Stable three-quarter top-down or low oblique compositions; one measured push or drift; enough depth to read members as an organization rather than points.
visual_styles.composition: Visually dominant scenes with intentional copy-safe space. Distinct roles must remain legible at nav/logo scale and expand into a richer living collective in hero media.
visual_styles.light: Warm directional studio light with restrained contrast and disciplined negative space.
visual_styles.material: Tactile ceramic, powder-coated metal, woven paper, subtle ground shadows, and one small glasslike checkpoint token.
visual_styles.motion: Members begin independently, align without losing shape, exchange one work object through brief signals, pause only the bounded path at a small checkpoint, then continue; paths disappear after handoff.

palette.rationale: Swarm coordination, not wax-seal brand theater: the warm paper and ink base makes the system feel inhabited and legible, while rust traces relationships, handoffs, and directed motion among differentiated roles. Green remains semantic and reserved for active authorization; revoked remains reserved for withdrawn or expired authority. A small seal survives only as a secondary state marker attached to an authorization, commitment, or completed checkpoint—not as the product symbol or ambient palette rationale.

typography.heading_font_family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif (KEPT from current live page)
typography.rationale: Family kept deliberately: research checked 2026-09-21 (typewolf.com/space-grotesk and madegooddesigns.com/space-grotesk-font) found Space Grotesk broadly signals forward-looking technology rather than authority by itself. The identity therefore comes from the living organization visual, not from inventing a more authoritative typeface. IBM Plex Mono is reserved for short, plain-language role, scope, handoff, priority, and status labels. It must not carry internal bracketed scope formats, IDs, decision keys, code vocabulary, or phase bookkeeping.

avoid: anonymous collective language that erases roles
grammar: Use agentic adjectivally and agent as a noun or concrete technical modifier.
Use active voice and concrete organizational subjects.
Do not concatenate swarm, governance, authority, and mechanism words into a compound category alias.
rules: Lead with organization and delegated outcomes, then explain authority and governance.
Name roles, responsibilities, scope, handoffs, priorities, checkpoints, and escalation in ordinary language.
Keep public copy concise; one declarative headline and one compact explanatory passage per major claim.
Distinguish designed future from running reference explicitly.
